task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel XRD pattern benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

anchoring_response.interpretation_notes: Single-panel XRD pattern plot with a full rectangular frame, legend inside the upper-right of the plotting area, and no inset. No explicit subpanel tag is visible in the image; this was treated as the only panel in the figure.

x.visible_pattern: Uniformly spaced x-axis ticks from 10 to 80 in 10-degree increments.
x.justification: Axis-fit validation chose a linear mapping with normalized RMSE about 0.00025; log10 was much worse.

y.visible_pattern: Uniformly spaced y-axis ticks from 0 to 1000 in 200 a.u. increments.
y.justification: Axis-fit validation chose a linear mapping with normalized RMSE about 0.00039; log10 is incompatible with the visible 0 tick.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: The three temperature traces are vertically separated and directly traceable; no overlap-recovery pass is warranted.

curves.suspected_gap_notes: First peak apex is clipped by the top plotting limit; only the visible shoulders are sampled there.

response.interpretation_notes: Single XRD panel with three vertically offset temperature-series traces. The 500 °C trace has one first-peak apex clipped by the top plotting limit, but the visible shoulders and the remaining pattern are clear.
unresolved_ambiguities: The 500 °C first peak exceeds the visible y-range and is clipped at the top border, so its exact apex is not observable.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
